mapper.sql: select c.*, u.nick_name owner_name, d.dept_name, ( select group_concat(t.tag_name order by t.order_num, t.tag_id separator ',') from biz_customer_tag_rel r inner join biz_customer_tag t on t.tag_id = r.tag_id and t.status = '0' where r.customer_id = c.customer_id ) tag_names, ( select group_concat(coalesce(t.tag_color, '') order by t.order_num, t.tag_id separator ',') from biz_customer_tag_rel r inner join biz_customer_tag t on t.tag_id = r.tag_id and t.status = '0' where r.customer_id = c.customer_id ) tag_colors, ( select count(1) from biz_contract bc where bc.customer_id = c.customer_id and bc.del_flag = '0' ) contract_count from biz_customer c left join sys_user u on u.user_id = c.owner_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = c.dept_id

sql.if: and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur inner join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id and r.status = '0' where ur.user_id = #{currentUserId} and ( #{permissions} is null or #{permissions} = '' or exists ( select 1 from sys_role_menu rm inner join sys_menu m on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id where rm.role_id = r.role_id and m.status = '0' and m.perms is not null and m.perms != '' and find_in_set(m.perms, #{permissions}) > 0 ) ) and ( r.data_scope = '1' or (r.data_scope = '2' and c.dept_id in (select rd.dept_id from sys_role_dept rd where rd.role_id = r.role_id)) or (r.data_scope = '3' and c.dept_id = #{currentDeptId}) or (r.data_scope = '4' and c.dept_id in (select sd.dept_id from sys_dept sd where sd.dept_id = #{currentDeptId} or find_in_set(#{currentDeptId}, sd.ancestors))) or (r.data_scope = '5' and c.owner_id = #{currentUserId}) ) )

if.test: (dataScope == null or !dataScope) and _parameter instanceof java.util.Map and params != null and params.dataScope != null and params.dataScope != ''

mapper.select: where c.customer_id = #{customerId}
where c.lead_id = #{leadId} and c.del_flag='0' limit 1

where c.del_flag='0' and ( (#{mobile} is not null and #{mobile} != '' and c.mobile = #{mobile}) or (#{creditCode} is not null and #{creditCode} != '' and c.credit_code = #{creditCode}) or (#{customerName} is not null and #{customerName} != '' and c.customer_name = #{customerName}) ) limit 1

and c.del_flag='0' and c.status != '2' and ( (#{mobile} is not null and #{mobile} != '' and c.mobile = #{mobile}) or (#{creditCode} is not null and #{creditCode} != '' and c.credit_code = #{creditCode}) or (#{customerName} is not null and #{customerName} != '' and c.customer_name = #{customerName}) )
order by c.customer_id desc limit 1

and c.del_flag='0' and c.status != '2' and c.customer_name = #{customerName}
order by c.customer_id desc limit 2

update biz_customer
customer_name=#{customerName},customer_type=#{customerType},mobile=#{mobile},wechat=#{wechat},email=#{email},company_name=#{companyName},credit_code=#{creditCode},industry=#{industry},region=#{region},source_code=#{sourceCode},customer_level=#{customerLevel},main_demand=#{mainDemand},owner_id=#{ownerId},dept_id=#{deptId},first_contact_time=#{firstContactTime},remark=#{remark}, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=sysdate()
where customer_id=#{customerId} and del_flag='0' and status != '2'
update biz_customer set del_flag='2', update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=sysdate() where del_flag='0' and status != '2' and customer_id in #{id}
mapper.select: select count(1) from biz_contract where customer_id=#{customerId} and del_flag='0'

select count(1) from biz_customer c where c.customer_id=#{customerId} and c.del_flag='0' and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur inner join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id and r.status='0' where ur.user_id=#{currentUserId} and ( #{permissions} is null or #{permissions} = '' or exists ( select 1 from sys_role_menu rm inner join sys_menu m on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id where rm.role_id = r.role_id and m.status = '0' and m.perms is not null and m.perms != '' and find_in_set(m.perms, #{permissions}) > 0 ) ) and (r.data_scope='1' or (r.data_scope='2' and c.dept_id in (select dept_id from sys_role_dept where role_id=r.role_id)) or (r.data_scope='3' and c.dept_id=#{currentDeptId}) or (r.data_scope='4' and c.dept_id in (select sd.dept_id from sys_dept sd where sd.dept_id=#{currentDeptId} or find_in_set(#{currentDeptId}, sd.ancestors))) or (r.data_scope='5' and c.owner_id=#{currentUserId})) )

select 'total' metricKey,count(*) metricValue from biz_customer c where del_flag='0' union all select 'monthNew',count(*) from biz_customer c where del_flag='0' and date_format(create_time,'%Y%m')=date_format(sysdate(),'%Y%m') union all select 'highValue',count(*) from biz_customer c where del_flag='0' and customer_level='1' union all select 'signed',count(distinct c.customer_id) from biz_customer c inner join biz_contract bc on bc.customer_id=c.customer_id and bc.del_flag='0' and bc.sign_status='1' where c.del_flag='0' union all select 'active',count(*) from biz_customer c where del_flag='0' and last_follow_time is not null
select customer_type itemName,count(*) itemValue from biz_customer c where del_flag='0' group by customer_type

select ct.*, c.customer_name customerName, u.nick_name ownerName from biz_customer_contact ct left join biz_customer c on c.customer_id=ct.customer_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=ct.owner_id
and ct.customer_id=#{customerId} and ct.contact_name like concat('%',#{contactName},'%') and c.customer_name like concat('%',#{customerName},'%') and ct.mobile like concat('%',#{mobile},'%') and ct.del_flag='0' and c.del_flag='0'
order by ct.key_contact desc, ct.contact_id desc
select customer_id from biz_customer_contact where contact_id=#{contactId} and del_flag='0'

select count(1) from biz_customer_contact where customer_id=#{customerId} and del_flag='0' and ( (#{mobile} is not null and #{mobile} != '' and mobile=#{mobile}) or (#{contactName} is not null and #{contactName} != '' and contact_name=#{contactName}) )
mapper.update: update biz_customer_contact set contact_name=#{contactName},position_name=#{positionName},mobile=#{mobile},wechat=#{wechat},email=#{email},relation_type=#{relationType},key_contact=#{keyContact},owner_id=#{ownerId},remark=#{remark},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where contact_id=#{contactId} and del_flag='0'
update biz_customer_contact set del_flag='2', update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=sysdate() where contact_id=#{contactId} and del_flag='0'

update biz_customer set last_follow_time=sysdate(), next_follow_time=#{nextFollowTime}, update_by=#{createBy}, update_time=sysdate() where customer_id=#{customerId}
mapper.select: select count(1) from biz_customer_tag where tag_id=#{tagId} and status='0'
select tag_id from biz_customer_tag_rel where customer_id=#{customerId}

select c.customer_id customerId,c.customer_no customerNo,c.customer_name customerName,c.mobile,c.credit_code creditCode,c.company_name companyName from biz_customer c where c.del_flag='0' and c.status='0' and c.customer_name like concat('%',#{customerName},'%') and c.mobile like concat('%',#{mobile},'%') and c.credit_code like concat('%',#{creditCode},'%')
order by c.customer_id desc

select l.merge_id logId, l.main_customer_id mainCustomerId, c.customer_name mainCustomerName, l.merged_customer_id mergedCustomerId, merged.customer_name mergedCustomerName, l.merge_content mergeContent, l.create_by createBy, l.create_time createTime from biz_customer_merge_log l inner join biz_customer c on c.customer_id = l.main_customer_id left join biz_customer merged on merged.customer_id = l.merged_customer_id
and (l.main_customer_id = #{customerId} or l.merged_customer_id = #{customerId})
order by l.create_time desc, l.merge_id desc
select contract_id from biz_contract where customer_id=#{customerId} and del_flag='0'

update biz_customer_followup set customer_id=#{toId}, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=sysdate() where customer_id=#{fromId} and del_flag='0'
